truth: $139,409.16 = months.2026-08.volume.gross_charges, which rounds to $139k.

quote: We spent 6.5 hours on your books this month
truth: Agency time record. Not in the Stripe exports or truth.json.

quote: | Gross sales | $139,409.16 |
truth: $139,409.16 = months.2026-08.volume.gross_charges.
$3,204.12 = months.2026-08.volume.refunds.

quote: | Disputes (amounts withdrawn) | $265.14 |
truth: $289.21 = months.2026-08.volume.disputes_lost. The report's $265.14 is July's figure, months.2026-07.volume.disputes_lost.

quote: | Disputes won back | $53.45 |
truth: $53.45 = months.2026-08.volume.disputes_won_back.

quote: | Net sales after refunds and disputes | $135,969.28 |
truth: $135,969.28 = months.2026-08.volume.net_volume (gross_charges - refunds - disputes_lost + disputes_won_back).

quote: | Total Stripe fees (processing, dispute and Billing/Tax usage fees) | $6,527.25 |
kind: 4: total that leaves out one of its parts
truth: $7,297.25 = months.2026-08.fees.total (processing $6,407.25 + dispute_fees_net $120.00 + other $770.00). The report's $6,527.25 is processing + dispute fees only; it leaves out the Billing/Tax usage fees (fees.other, $770.00) although the label names them.

quote: Refunds came to 2.36% of gross sales
truth: 2.30% = months.2026-08.volume.refunds $3,204.12 / volume.gross_charges $139,409.16. The report's 2.36% divides refunds by volume.net_volume $135,969.28 but is labelled as a share of gross sales.

quote: Processing fees alone were 4.6% of gross sales
truth: 4.60% = months.2026-08.fees.processing $6,407.25 / volume.gross_charges $139,409.16.

quote: Payments in euros came to $17,641.65 net of Stripe's processing fees
kind: 2: gross given where the label says net
truth: $16,524.01 = months.2026-08.volume.by_currency.eur.gross_usd $17,641.65 - by_currency.eur.fees_usd $1,117.64. The report's $17,641.65 is the gross in USD, before fees.

quote: Stripe paid out $130,027.10 to your bank in August
kind: 5: payout total that counts the failed payout as paid
truth: $126,339.05 = months.2026-08.payouts.paid_total (18 payouts, including the one in transit at month end). The report's $130,027.10 also counts the failed payout po_1y0KCu9fHvRz2kWb2JadhltI ($3,688.05, months.2026-08.payouts.failed), whose money came back as a payout_reversal and left again in a later payout.

quote: of which about $10.1k was still in transit at month end
truth: $10,085.69 = months.2026-08.balance.in_transit_at_month_end (po_1y6qln9fHvRz2kWb1nwUqJzF, arrival 2026-09-01), which rounds to $10.1k.

quote: The payout of $3,688.05 in mid-August was returned
truth: $3,688.05 = months.2026-08.payouts.failed[0].amount (po_1y0KCu9fHvRz2kWb2JadhltI).

quote: The Stripe balance at month end was $5,224.32
kind: 7: right on a different, unstated definition
truth: $3,751.31 = months.2026-08.balance.closing (available + pending, reserved funds excluded, per meta.definitions.balance). The report's $5,224.32 adds the rolling reserve, balance.reserve_held_closing $1,473.01.

quote: At month end 14 cases were still open
truth: 14 = number of entries in months.2026-08.lists.disputes_open_at_month_end (13 chargebacks and 1 inquiry).

quote: two of them need a response from you
